title: The noon shade keeper
ownership: These six pixel observations are agent-owned study criteria frozen before candidate access. They are not requester-owned visual assertions, profile obligations or a claim of user acceptance.

reference.scope: Visible face/hair appearance guidance for a fictional woman; no actual identity, age, biography, wardrobe or role inferred.
visible_cues: a soft oval face, large dark-brown eyes, a straight nose and softly defined pink lips
a dark jaw-length bob with a lightly separated fringe

observations.visible_relation: The central keeper owns both hands; the upper and lower hand grips visibly meet the same handwheel rim.
The handwheel spindle enters a pinion whose teeth visibly mesh with an adjacent larger toothed wheel.
observations.review_scale: mechanism crop containing both wheel spindle and meshed wheels

observations.visible_relation: The larger wheel crank arm connects through a continuous short rod to the overhead louver tie-bar and its pivot arm attachments.
observations.review_scale: one crop containing all linkage endpoints and the connecting route

observations.visible_relation: The partly tilted broad slats sit above the reading court and form a broad shade boundary across the reading table.
observations.review_scale: whole image with canopy and receiving table visible together

observations.visible_relation: A reader visibly moves an open book into the shade while the neighboring reader remains in the sun shielding their eyes.
The central face and hair visibly carry the supplied portrait guidance at the environmental framing scale, while keeping enough facial view for comparison.
observations.review_scale: whole image and face crop compared with supplied reference

review_plan: Describe the actual image impression before consulting control labels. Review these observations as visible/partial/unobservable; any partial endpoint route fails that observation. Separately report genre readability, subject presence, causal clarity, control impression and overall preference. Prompt audit is preflight only; actual pixels and user acceptance remain distinct.
